# Execute Issue Checkpoint

<!-- aether-continuity-disposition: reader-writer -->

## Repository continuity composition

Compose `maintain-repository-continuity` in Resume mode after scoped instructions
and canonical source. Save meaningful intermediate progress within actual role
permissions. After domain checks, use **Refresh** and **Verify** before PR handoff;
record a permitted no-change/exemption result instead of an artificial edit.

- **Contribute:** Parent/checkpoint identity, scope coverage, saved progress, actual validation and exact resume action
- **Never claim:** That a saved branch, draft PR or closed issue proves unrun checks, merge or consumer delivery

## Governing workflow

Apply `worker-strategy`0.2.0 from the same selected immutable Aether installation.
Reuse `repository-continuity`, `local-validation-evidence`,
`github-issue-authoring` and `reconcile-roadmap-impact`; their contracts retain
handoff, evidence, issue-authoring and strategic ownership. This skill creates
no scheduler, issue service, knowledge store or second continuity format.

## Size and recognize work

1. Inspect the live issue, original acceptance, known parent/child IDs, explicit
   link-based groups, dependencies and active branches/PRs. Titles and emoji are
   not stable identity. Check closed work before proposing replacements.
2. Execute a sufficiently small issue unchanged. For larger scope, preserve the
   parent and choose the smallest independently reviewable split, often two
   checkpoints. Map every original criterion to retained work or an explicit
   owner-reviewed disposition; preserve discussion and active references.
3. Reuse existing checkpoint structure when it already covers the scope. A
   progress save is not another sub-issue. Parent/group links do not imply
   prerequisite edges; record real blockers separately, including external owners.
4. Select one checkpoint and its current role, bounded outcome, exclusions,
   acceptance, necessary checks, named deferred work and stopping point. A caller
   may authorize a longer batch; this skill does not force a new approval between
   already authorized checkpoints or impose an arbitrary time limit.

## Execute, save and hand off

Work within existing authority and scoped instructions. Preserve concurrent or
unrelated edits. Perform necessary overwrite/security/interface controls before
relying on affected behavior; a scheduling deferral changes no check outcome.
Record actual command/revision coverage and failed, unrun or unavailable work.

Save after durable decisions, useful milestones, explicit checkpoint requests,
before planned handoffs and when context/scope becomes uncertain. When authorized
and available, commit/push reviewable progress and create/update the existing
draft PR. One checkpoint may have several saves. If tools or permission are
unavailable, report the actual local saved state and delivery blocker. Never
discard work or manufacture a pushed PR.

Use the [handoff template](templates/HANDOFF.template.md) within the consumer's
established work-record location, or the governing default
`docs/work/<parent-issue-number>/HANDOFF.md`. Root continuity remains a bounded
current entry point. Preserve deferred obligations in the durable work record
when another issue becomes active; do not turn continuity into a transcript.

Before presenting the PR, perform domain validation, decision-impact and
roadmap-impact reconciliation, then continuity refresh/verify. Distinguish
prepared, validated, review-ready, merged and delivered. Update child/parent
progress only from actual scoped acceptance; keep parents open when required
verification or delivery remains unfinished. Automatic issue-closing keywords
do not supply evidence or merge authority.

## Resume in a fresh session

Read shared/local instructions and selected owner contracts, then continuity and
the linked work record. Verify actual working tree, branch/head, PR/issue state
and dependency evidence; reconcile stale or concurrent changes before editing.
Recover the exact next action from source records without needing the previous
chat. If provider access is missing, preserve that unknown state rather than
assume a draft merged or a check passed. Abrupt failure before a save can lose
work; no static instruction guarantees a warning, zero loss or automatic recovery.

## Examples and limits

The [synthetic examples](references/examples.md) cover unsplit/split/reused
checkpoints, independent groups, interruption, stale/concurrent state, denied
writes and unavailable hosted checks. Deterministic fixtures validate declared
scope coverage, state distinctions and generated module composition. They do
not qualify model judgment, live host enforcement or effectiveness in a real
consumer. Aether#67 and organization issue23 own reviewed default-bundle/fleet
consumption; this source does not perform that rollout.

## Provenance and privacy

First-party Ego Hygiene content for Aether#92, extending the existing
worker-strategy source rather than importing or executing staged material.
Historical Aniflow13 informed the distinction between link-based checkpoints,
local qualification and explicit deferred hosted work; its permissions and
domain instructions do not transfer here. Preserve private source within its
boundary and publish only reviewed public-safe summaries. No real transcript,
personal/financial detail, private path or protected topology is a fixture.
